name: print-social-red-hiring-square-post-with-megaphone-on-chair
title: Red square 'We Are Hiring!' post with a megaphone on a red chair and translucent role list
whatItIs: A square red version of the chair-and-megaphone hiring layout: boxed 'WE ARE' and 'PROFESSIONAL' words in a big white headline, a black megaphone on a red chair, a translucent panel of open positions, CV email, WhatsApp and a white curved footer with perks.
whatItMeans: Clear and eye-catching; tone-on-tone red keeps focus on the message and the witty prop.
techniques: Keep background, chair and panel in one red family.
Box selected words in the headline.
Adapt the same layout across story and feed sizes.

vocabulary.definition: Shades of one colour used together.
Reworking one design for different sizes.
